Hello! My name is Lise., I was born in Montreal and grew up in Irvine, California. I'm just starting my Master's in Data Science at UBC this fall in the year 2026. I hold a B.S.c. in Biology from Concordia University, and previously worked in veterinary care and AI data annotation. Outside data science, I'm passionate about animal welfare — I've fostered over 60 cats for the Montreal SPCA — and I'm a novice baker, a book-lover, and an avid tennis player.
